2607.22516.title: Quantum Spectral Model: Data Reuploading with Input-Conditioned Frequency Support
2607.22516.paper_summary: A central design principle in modern machine learning and artificial intelligence is to align a model's inductive bias with the structure of its input data. For matrix-valued inputs, relevant matrix-level relationships can be characterised through spectral values and spectral subspaces; however, common coordinate-wise rotation-gate data-encoding unitaries used in most quantum machine learning models do not explicitly construct such a matrix-level representation. We introduce Quantum Spectral Models (QSMs), in which we construct the generator of the data-encoding unitary directly from each input matrix. We study three QSM variants based on symmetric, global block, and non-overlapping patch-local block Hamiltonians. Their outputs admit truncated Fourier representations in which input-dependent spectral gaps supply candidate phase carriers, while spectral subspaces help determine their coefficients. We evaluate the QSMs and comparison quantum models on two matrix representations of Pendigits and two controlled synthetic tasks defined by spectral statistics. At the largest evaluated circuit depth, QSM variants lead the tested quantum models in mean test accuracy across all four benchmarks. The patch-local QSM leads on Pendigits, whereas the global block-Hamiltonian QSM leads on the controlled spectral tasks. Ablations show a task-dependent reversal: subspace-preserving controls perform better on Pendigits, whereas spectral-value-only controls lead among the tested ablations on the synthetic tasks. Together, these results shed new light on quantum machine-learning model design by showing how input-conditioned spectral representations can provide an analysable inductive bias, while offering a broader perspective on structure-aware model design in machine learning and artificial intelligence.
2607.22516.paper_summary_zh: 現代機器學習和人工智慧中的一個核心設計原則是將模型的歸納偏差與其輸入數據的結構對齊。<lb/>對於矩陣值輸入，相關的矩陣級關係可以通過譜值和譜子空間來表徵；然而，大多數量子機器學習模型中使用的常見坐標方向旋轉閘數據編碼單元並未明確構建這樣的矩陣級表示。<lb/>我們介紹量子譜模型（QSMs），在這些模型中，我們直接從每個輸入矩陣構建數據編碼單元的生成器。<lb/>我們研究了基於對稱、全局區塊和不重疊補丁局部區塊哈密頓量的三種QSM變體。<lb/>它們的輸出允許截斷傅里葉表示，其中依賴於輸入的譜間隙提供候選相位載體，而譜子空間有助於確定它們的係數。<lb/>我們在Pendigits的兩個矩陣表示和兩個由譜統計定義的受控合成任務上評估QSM和比較量子模型。<lb/>在評估的最大電路深度下，QSM變體在所有四個基準中在平均測試準確度上領先於測試的量子模型。<lb/>補丁局部QSM在Pendigits上領先，而全局區塊哈密頓量QSM在受控譜任務上領先。<lb/>消融實驗顯示出任務依賴的逆轉：保持子空間的控制在Pendigits上表現更好，而僅使用譜值的控制在合成任務的測試消融中領先。<lb/>總的來說，這些結果為量子機器學習模型設計提供了新見解，顯示了如何利用輸入條件的譜表示來提供可分析的歸納偏差，同時為機器學習和人工智慧中的結構感知模型設計提供了更廣泛的視角。
